summary: LMS is a self-hosted audio streaming server that lets you access your personal music collection through a standard web interface. Written in C++, it is designed to run on your own hardware so you can stream your audio files remotely. The project is actively maintained with regular tagged releases under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want a dedicated, self-hosted web player for their local music library without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: As an audio streaming platform focusing on a web interface, it competes in a crowded field alongside more mature alternatives like Navidrome or Plex, meaning you might find fewer community plugins or client apps.
deployNotes: You can deploy it using Docker or standard Debian packages, and you will typically need to map persistent storage for your music files and configure a reverse proxy to handle secure HTTPS access.
